Terms of Use

Last updated: November 8, 2026

Welcome to DoraPDF. By using dorapdf.com (the "Service") you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

1. The Service

DoraPDF provides free online tools for working with PDFs, images, documents and calculations. Most tools run entirely in your web browser. We may add, change or remove tools at any time.

2. Your files and content

You keep all rights to the files and content you process. Because processing happens on your device, we do not receive, store or claim any rights over your files. You are responsible for making sure you have the right to use, convert or modify any file you process.

3. Acceptable use

You agree not to use DoraPDF to:

  • process content you do not have the right to use, or that infringes someone else's copyright or privacy;

4. Calculators and estimates

Our calculators (for example loan, mortgage, salary, BMI, calorie and due date calculators) provide estimates for general information only. They are not financial, legal, medical or professional advice. Always confirm important decisions with a qualified professional.

5. No warranty

The Service is provided "as is" and "as available". While we work hard to make our tools accurate and reliable, we do not guarantee that results will be error-free or that the Service will always be available. Please keep a copy of your original files.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, DoraPDF and Phyntx are not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages, or for any loss of data, profits or business, arising from your use of the Service.

8. Assignment Helper: accounts, plans and payments

Accounts. You sign in with a verified Google account. Each account is for one person only. An account can be signed in on one device at a time: signing in on a new device signs out the previous one. Sharing, reselling or automating access to an account is not allowed.

Free trial. New accounts get a 3-day free trial with 3 assignments and 3 presentations. One trial per person.

Plans. Pro ($6/month, normally $12) includes 6 assignments and 6 presentations per month. Max ($19/month, normally $29) includes unlimited assignments and presentations under fair use (up to 30 creations per day). Prices in Pakistani rupees are shown at checkout. Plans run for 30 days from activation and must be renewed each month to continue; unused credits do not roll over.

Payments and refunds. Card and PayPal payments are processed by our reseller Paddle.com, which is the Merchant of Record for those orders and sends your invoice by email. Local payments (JazzCash, Easypaisa, NayaPay) are activated after we confirm the transaction. You can ask for a full refund within 14 days of your first payment of a plan, as described in our Refund policy. You can cancel at any time and your plan stays active until the end of the paid period.

Misuse. We may suspend or end an account if it is shared between people, used to abuse or overload the service, used with automated tools, or used to break the law or our acceptable-use rules. If you think we made a mistake, email hello@dorapdf.com.

A study helper, not a submission service. The Assignment Helper creates outlines, starting drafts, slide decks and lists of sources to help you learn and plan your own work. AI-generated text can contain mistakes and references must be checked. Do not submit generated content as your own work where your school does not allow it; you are responsible for following your institution's academic-integrity rules.

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes means you accept the updated Terms.

These Terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan.
